time_sync: JointState header and ros_time_s use MuJoCo simulation time; callback arrival time is used for freshness. Bag storage timestamps use wall time.
missing_data: Blank CSV cells mean unavailable or stale measurements.
safety: Trajectory dimensions are unvalidated research examples and are never sufficient for real motion approval.
sim_model: ag145_scene.xml (generated from dsr_description2 A0509 and dh_ag145_description)

gripper_model.visual_orientation: URDF fixed-axis RPY converted to MJCF quaternion

physics_source: Separate MuJoCo model reconstructed from measured q/dq/ddq; qfrc_actuator unavailable from upstream bridge
acceleration_method: finite difference of observed JointState velocity; blank if velocity unavailable
sim_initialization: Cartesian trials first move the simulator to (-0.5, -0.5, 1.6, 0, -0.6, 0) rad; this setup move is outside the recorded trajectory

torque_definitions.actual_motor_torque: DRFL motor-current/gear conversion [Nm], not an independent torque sensor
torque_definitions.actual_joint_torque: DRFL controller-estimated joint torque [Nm], not an independent torque sensor
torque_definitions.qfrc_inverse: MuJoCo inverse-dynamics generalized force [Nm for hinge DOFs]
torque_definitions.qfrc_actuator: MuJoCo actuator generalized force [Nm for hinge DOFs] when directly available
torque_definitions.qfrc_applied: MuJoCo externally applied generalized force [Nm for hinge DOFs] if ROS JointState effort is exported
torque_definitions.qfrc_bias: MuJoCo bias generalized force [Nm for hinge DOFs]

validation: IK position/orientation convergence and conservative joint limits; no physical robot involved
scene_visual_revision: Visual-only orientation corrected after acquisition; mass, TCP, collision boxes, and recorded dynamics unchanged.
